texts.zh:
我们的远程扫描仪发现了一个在系统边缘漂浮的物体。进一步检查发现其外表下存在精确的几何不一致，以及厚厚岩石外壳下埋藏的休眠能量信号。

这是一个来源不明的救生舱，其外部经过伪装，以躲避广阔太空中的探测。未检测到任何主动传输，但舱内仍存在微弱的生命维持痕迹。无论里面是什么，都已经漂浮了很长时间。
texts.en:
Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.

A survival pod of unknown origin, its exterior was camouflaged to evade detection across vast stretches of space. No active transmissions were detected, but faint life-support traces persisted within. Whatever lay inside had been adrift for a very long time.

label.zh: 让我们看看里面有什么。
就把这石头当石头看吧。
label.en: Let the rock be a rock.

texts.zh:
矿物外壳之下，我们发现了一个严重受损的休眠舱。舱内有一名乘员，早已死亡。此人的身体披着华丽的仪式长袍，不适合太空旅行。看来此人是被仓促地强行塞进去的。

休眠舱内部有明显的暴力痕迹。几处内部束缚装置曾被强行使用。这个容器并非避难所，而是一个囚牢。只找到了两件物品：一组坐标和一封密封的信件。上面刻着简单的铭文：

“致吾爱。”
texts.en:
Beneath the mineral shell, we uncovered a badly damaged stasis pod. Inside we discovered a single occupant, already deceased. Their body was draped in flowing ceremonial vestments, not suited for spacefaring. It appears they were forced inside in haste.

The pod's interior bore unmistakable signs of violence. Several internal restraints had been forcibly engaged. This vessel was no sanctuary; it was a prison. Only two artifacts could be recovered: a set of coordinates, and a sealed message. It bore a simple inscription: 

"For my Beloved."

label.zh: 设置前往该坐标的航线。
我们不应该在这上面浪费时间。
label.en: We should not waste our time on this.

texts.zh:
我们终于抵达了由恢复的坐标所指向的休眠舱。在里面，我们发现了另一个生物，它还奄奄一息。

身体损伤非常严重。长期的休眠失败让[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]濒临死亡。两个休眠舱显然很久以前就已分离，从未抵达目的地。

我们已经稳定住了这个外星人，它要求我们称呼[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]为[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]。完全康复仍遥遥无期。
texts.en:
We have finally arrived at the capsule indicated by the recovered coordinates. Within, we discovered another being, this one still barely alive.

The physical damage is severe. Prolonged stasis failure has left [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] on the verge of death. The two pods had clearly been separated long ago, their destination never reached.

We have stabilized the alien, who has asked us to call [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]. Full recovery remains far from certain.

label.zh: 确保[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe]能够康复。

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词是在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录的：

“发生了一场大屠杀。整个家庭被抹去。根据官方通告，那是一个敌对帝国的袭击。但那是一个谎言。当权者自己策划了这一切，一个捏造的暴行，只为了一场毫无意义的战争辩护。我的爱人和我找到了证据。内部指令。未篡改的日志。

“我们发布了它。我们预料到了后果。我们没有预料到的是流放。”

休眠舱数据库虽然有所损坏，但该记录可恢复。这份记录现在掌握在我们手中。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"There was a massacre. Whole families, erased. It was presented as an attack by a rival empire. But that was a lie. Those in power had orchestrated it themselves, a fabricated atrocity to justify a senseless war. My beloved and I found the proof. Internal directives. Unaltered logs.

"We released it. We expected consequences. What we did not expect was exile."

Corrupted but recoverable records from the pod's data banks are already in our possession.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

“舰队已然逼近，我们早在他们抵达之前就看到了。自我们拒绝[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]的臣服要求以来，他们已经对我们发动了多年的战争。我们的军队实力悬殊，根本无法匹敌。

“最终，我的父母将他们的希望寄托在这些休眠舱上。他们把我和我所爱的人强行送入虚空，我们的生存渺茫，我们的重逢只能听天由命，只希望能重新开始。”

对休眠舱系统进行调查后，我们发现了许多战时工程数据。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"The fleets were already on approach, we saw them long before they reached us. [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] had waged war against us for years, ever since we refused their demands for vassalage. Our forces were hopelessly outmatched.

"In the end, my parents placed their faith in these capsules. They forced my beloved and me into the void, our survival uncertain, our reunion left to chance with only the hope that we might begin anew."

A survey of the pod's systems has turned up engineering data from the war period.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了其陈述：

“我们的帝国曾以尊重生命和死亡为荣。我们的宗旨是延长生命，并减轻生死之间的过渡，但绝不是完全超越它。通过机械飞升实现永生，是对我们信仰的亵渎。这种知识本不该被掌握。但好奇心在民众中蔓延开来。当它无法再被遏制时，统治当局认为风险不可接受。

“他们选择了抹除。我们的帝国被摧毁以埋葬真相。只有我和我的爱人幸免于难，被迫进入这些休眠舱，注定在生与死之间漂泊。”

休眠舱的数据核心也已解密。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"Our empire once took great pride in honoring both life and death. Our purpose was to prolong existence and ease the passage between them, but never to transcend it entirely. Immortality, through synthetic ascension, was an abomination to our beliefs. Such knowledge was never meant to be possessed. But curiosity spread among the population. When it could no longer be contained, the ruling authority deemed the risk unacceptable.

"They chose erasure. Our empire was destroyed to bury the truth. Only my beloved and I were spared, forced into these pods, condemned to drift between life and death."

The pod's data core has also been decrypted.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录下了这份自述：

“我有个同事。一个朋友，至少我是这么认为的。我们一起工作了好几年。当我被任命领导这个项目时，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe]向我表示了祝贺。

“一个月后，我和我的爱人被捕了。莫须有的罪名。没有审判。我还没来得及问为什么，我们就被关进了休眠舱。我现在明白了，野心不需要理由。它只需要一个机会。”

来自休眠舱内部系统的个人日志为我们提供了帝国治理的详细记录。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"I had a colleague. A friend, or so I believed. We had worked together for years. When I was appointed to lead the project, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe] offered congratulations.

"A month later, my beloved and I were seized. Fabricated charges. No trial. We were put into the pods before I had finished asking why. I know now that ambition does not need a reason. It only needs an opportunity."

Personal logs from the pod's internal systems have given us a detailed record of the empire's governance.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的陈述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

“一种无情的病毒席卷了我们的帝国。我们的人民迅速而无情地死去。据信它起源于我们庞大的垃圾填埋场之一，这是我们自身过度和粗心大意的后果。我所爱的人和我在末日来临之前选择与我们的人民站在一起。

“但我的父母介入了。违背我们的意愿，我们被迫进入这些休眠仓，被抛弃。这项技术本应保存我们。看来它失败了。”

已回收休眠仓生命维持系统中的生物残留物。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"A relentless virus swept through our empire. Our people perished swiftly and without mercy. It is believed to have originated from one of our vast landfill complexes, a consequence of our own excess and carelessness. My beloved and I chose to remain to stand with our people until the end.

"But my parents intervened. Against our will, we were forced into these pods and cast away. The technology was meant to preserve us. It seems it failed."

Biological residue from the pod's life support systems has been recovered.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在康复期间完整记录了[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的叙述：

“我的父母知道[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]即将苏醒。为了获得它的青睐，他们不惜一切代价达成了一项交易。我们四分之一的人口被献祭，以换取力量。我和我的爱人发现了他们的阴谋。

“但很少有人听信，而那些听信的人则被灭口。我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入虚空，如同之前许多人一样，被抛弃了。”

休眠舱密封舱室中的文件已被发现。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"My parents knew that [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] was on the verge of awakening. Desperate to secure its favor, they struck a bargain. A quarter of our population was offered in exchange for power. My beloved and I uncovered their design.

"But few listened, and those who did were silenced. We were forced into these pods and cast into the void, discarded, as so many others had been before us."

Documentation from the pod's sealed compartments has been uncovered.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了他的陈述：

“我并非因我所做之事而被流放。我是因我所爱之人而被流放。

“我们的人民正在交战。我们已交战了数代。在我们人民眼中，我们的结合是一种无法被忽视的逾矩。我们拒绝分开，相信我们的结合或许能展示和平的价值。

“我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入无尽的虚空。但我们的爱无法被割裂。”

在该休眠舱中发现了两位流亡者之间的私人通信。阅读它们令人深受鼓舞。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"I was not exiled for what I had done. I was exiled for who I loved.

"Our people were at war. We had been, for generations. In the eyes of our people, our bond was a transgression, one that could not be ignored. We refused to part, believing that our bond might demonstrate the value of peace.

"We were forced into these pods and cast into the relentless void. But our love could not be sundered."

Private correspondence between the two exiles was found in the pod. Reading it was inspiring.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的自述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

“它最初只是思绪边缘的一个存在。后来我听到了声音。低语声一直跟着我，随着时间的推移变得越来越清晰，说的是一些零碎的词句。我的人民害怕我变成了什么样子，但我的爱人一直在我身边。

“我们一起被迫进入这个逃生舱，被抛入虚空，在任何可能触及我心智的东西扩散之前就被移走了。即使现在，我仍然能听到它。低语着。”

逃生舱的传感器日志揭示了大量有趣的数据。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"It began as a presence at the edge of thought. Then I heard the voice. The whispers followed me, growing clearer with time, speaking in fragments. My people feared what I had become, but my beloved stayed by my side.

"Together, we were forced into this pod and cast into the void, removed before whatever had touched my mind could spread. Even now, I still hear it. Whispering."

The pod's sensor logs have revealed an intriguing amount of data.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

texts.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的状况迅速恶化。就在其临终前不久，我们解密了伴侣舱发出的加密信息。信息内容如下：

“我的挚爱，

如果你听到这段话，那么命运对你比对我更仁慈。请知道，即使在虚空中，我也从未孤单，我始终与你同在。”

信息结束后不久，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的生命体征停止了。自从苏醒以来，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的表情第一次如此平静。
texts.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s condition deteriorated rapidly. Shortly before their passing, we decrypted the sealed message from the companion pod. The transmission reads:

"My dearest,

"If you hear this, then fate has been kinder to you than it was to me. Know that, even in the void, I was never alone, I carried you with me, always."

Moments after the message concluded, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s vital signs ceased. For the first time since awakening, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] expression was at peace.

label.zh: 安息吧，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]。

texts.zh: 一个密封的信息和一组从漂流的休眠舱中回收的坐标。无论它们背后隐藏着什么故事，它都等待了很长时间才被世人发现。
texts.en: A sealed message and a set of coordinates recovered from a drifting stasis pod. Whatever story lies behind them, it has waited a long time to be told.

texts.zh: 我们必须仔细扫描该物体，以确定其来源以及内部是否有任何东西在漫长的虚空漂流中幸存下来。
texts.en: We must carefully scan the object to determine its origin and whether anything inside has survived the long drift through the void.

texts.en: We must fly to the indicated system and scan the pod to determine whether its occupant still lives.
